verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Realtime is WebRTC media infrastructure (SFU, TURN, RealtimeKit). Comparable realtime platforms can host voice or AI agents that consume tools, so this axis plausibly applies. The evidence pack never shows the product acting as an MCP client or connecting to MCP servers. The Workers AI transcription and AI meeting summaries are adjacent AI features, not MCP tool consumption.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
